sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This site is a static portfolio. It does not use advertising trackers.
It may use Google Analytics to understand aggregate traffic (pages viewed, approximate location, device). That data is used to see whether the site is useful, not to identify you personally.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: When Google Analytics is enabled, Google may collect usage data under Google’s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
This site does not set its own first-party tracking cookies. Google may set cookies for analytics. You can block cookies in your browser.
